capability.name: AID record lookup and validation (_agent TXT, AID v2.1.1)
capability.description: What an Agent Identity & Discovery client finds for a domain. Give a domain: two public DNS-over-HTTPS resolvers are asked for TXT at _agent.<domain> (that exact host), each answer is parsed and validated by the AID v2.1.1 rules, aid2 is preferred and two valid records are refused as ambiguous. Returns the selected record, the keyid an endpoint proof must name when the record has k, each resolver's answer with its DNSSEC flag, and the specification's error code (1000, 1001, 1002, 1004) when discovery fails. Or give txt to validate a record before you publish it, with no lookup.

domain.description: host to look up, e.g. example.com (A-label for an IDN)

txt.description: instead of domain: one TXT string or a list of up to 16 to validate without a lookup

at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time to judge the dep (deprecation) field against; a lookup uses the resolver's Date

note: agent discovery check for the DNS record a domain publishes about its agent
